data.name: Moss Tonic
data.description: Restore 35 health. The green of Hollowmere still remembers how to heal.

data.name: Focus Draught
data.description: Restore 30 focus for the Lantern Bolt.

data.name: Sun Sigil of Moss
data.description: One of the three suns. The crown door answers to its green light.

data.name: Sun Sigil of Tides
data.description: One of the three suns. It is cold, but it burns.

data.name: Sun Sigil of Embers
data.description: One of the three suns. It remembers the last hearth.

data.name: HOLLOWMERE
data.subtitle: The Lantern Below
data.intro: The Lantern Tree is going dark. Three suns sleep in the drowned kingdom, and the Hollow King remembers every trespass. Carry the lantern. Break the crown.

pickups.label: Wayfarer’s Note
pickups.text: The Lantern Tree dims. Three suns were hidden in the roots, the archive, and the keep.

npcs.name: Brann Emberhand
npcs.title: KEEPER OF THE FIRST FORGE
npcs.line: Steel remembers every blow. Bring me ember-shards and I will make yours worth remembering.

doors.label: Windroot Arch
doors.message: A windroot sigil is needed to ride the high arch.

pickups.label: Gallery Tablet
pickups.text: The first sun sleeps where roots wear stone like armor.

pickups.label: Shrine Inscription
pickups.text: To pass the empty crown, carry three suns and no doubt.

npcs.name: Mara, Root Scholar
npcs.title: READER OF THE ROOTWAYS
npcs.line: The archive drowned, but its doors remember. Find the wall-grip and the deep stacks will open for you.

doors.label: Burrow Gate
doors.message: The rootway pinches shut. An emberstep sigil could carry you through.

pickups.label: Rootway Mark
pickups.text: A quick dash leaves the dark one breath behind.

doors.label: Archive Stair
doors.message: The wall is too smooth for mortal fingers. Rootgrip would hold.

pickups.label: Archive Plaque
pickups.text: The tide sigil is catalogued beneath the drowned stacks.

pickups.label: Drowned Catalogue
pickups.text: The second sun was kept beneath water that forgot how to drown.

doors.label: The Hollow Throne
doors.message: Three sun sigils must burn in the crown before the throne opens.

pickups.label: Throne Inscription
pickups.text: No crown can hold a king who has forgotten his name.

abilities.name: Lantern Saber
abilities.description: A three-step blade combination. The third strike lunges through the dark.

abilities.name: Windroot
abilities.description: A second leap in the air. The windroot catches your heels.

abilities.name: Emberstep
abilities.description: A quick ground or air dash that leaves danger one breath behind.

abilities.name: Rootgrip
abilities.description: Hold into a wall to slow the fall and leap away from it.

abilities.name: Lantern Bolt
abilities.description: Spend 10 focus to loose a piercing ember of lantern-light.

victory.title: THE LANTERN RISES
victory.text: The Hollow King falls, and the three suns answer the lantern. For the first time in an age, morning reaches Hollowmere.
